tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background: paper white in light, as HyperOS 4 apps are, so content sits in grey wells rather than white cards on grey; true black in dark so OLED pixels switch off around photos.

tokens.name: group
tokens.usage: Grouped wells and list groups on `canvas`: a pale grey well on the paper-white page in light, near-black in dark. Never place a `group` on another `group`.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Floating controls: raised circle buttons, segmented thumb, the selected filter pill, dialogs in dark. One step lighter than `group` in dark.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed fills: search capsule, segmented track, text field, and secondary (Cancel) buttons in dark mode; in light mode those buttons are `lift`.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px dividers inside a group (inset to the text start) and the outline of an unselected chip. Decorative only; never the only cue for state.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `canvas`, `group`, `raised` and `sunken` (16:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: summaries, timestamps, counts, inactive tab labels. 4.8:1+ on `canvas`, `group` and `sunken` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled glyphs and decorative icons. 3:1 on `group`; never for text a person must read.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The single signal colour (Ember, the 72F sun), vivid in both themes. Primary buttons, switches, the selected tab, links, focus ring, the 72F wordmark. Tuned as bright as ColorOS and vivo fills: about 2.6:1 on `canvas` in light (a deliberate, small step under the WCAG 3:1 for UI components, traded for vividness) and well over 3:1 in dark. Use it for fills, icons, controls and semibold labels, never for body text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill: white in light (about 2.9:1, so set it in `label` weight or heavier and at 18dp or larger for glyphs), black in dark (6.9:1).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill for tinted buttons, the chosen row in a picker and accent notices: a pale wash in light; in dark, `raised` grey with an 8% hint of the accent, so warm hues never turn brown.

tokens.name: on-accent-soft
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent-soft`: the bright accent itself (semibold labels and icons).

tokens.name: horizon
tokens.usage: The Horizon glow: a radial wash of the accent at the top of top-level screens, fading into `canvas` within the header. Decorative, never under body text.

tokens.name: glass-tint
tokens.usage: Base colour of every glass surface. Mixed over the scattered backdrop at the opacity the Glass level sets: 94% at the opaque end, 70% Frosted (the default: about 30% of the frosted page shows through), 42% Glass, 16% Liquid, 0% at Clear.

tokens.name: glass-lit
tokens.usage: Resting filter pills and tabs in floating chrome (header filters, tabs on the veil): a glass pebble coated in this tint. In light mode it is the same white glass as the glass buttons beside them; in dark mode a step lighter than the glass. The chosen pill is a solid `accent` pebble instead. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: Resting pills and tabs in a group, and secondary buttons in light mode, the same white as the glass buttons. A step lighter than `sunken` in dark mode, white with `shadow-raise` in light. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: glass-heat
tokens.usage: The colour temperature of the light glass carries in from its bottom edge, and of the warmth a finger leaves. Follows the accent: a pale, bright version of the accent (warm for Ember, cool for Glacier, neutral white for Graphite).

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: Hairline just outside a glass shape that separates it from busy content.

tokens.name: glass-ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text and icons on glass. Darker (light) or lighter (dark) than `ink-2` because glass lets the backdrop through; the glass contrast floor keeps it at 4.5:1 at every level.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimmed layer behind sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: media
tokens.usage: Ground of the photo and video viewer in both themes.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Success icons and semibold labels ("Synced", "Backed up") on `canvas`, `group` and `positive-soft`, about 2.4:1 in light, chosen for vividness. Always paired with an icon or word.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind positive status pills and notices.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Warning icons and semibold labels ("Storage almost full") on `canvas`, `group` and `caution-soft`, about 2.6:1 in light, chosen for vividness. Bright amber, never brown.

tokens.name: caution-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind caution pills and notices.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions (Delete, Sign out): a true red, never the accent and never coral, so a destructive action reads as a warning at a glance. Danger buttons are solid `critical` with white text (4.9:1 in light, 4.2:1 in dark); as text it is semibold, always paired with an icon or verb.

tokens.name: critical-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind critical notices and the swipe-to-delete action.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral system information ("Indexing 1,204 photos") on `canvas`, `group` and `info-soft`.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind info notices.

styles.name: masthead
styles.usage: The massive title centred in a top-level page's opening; it shrinks to `title` size and slides to the top-start corner of the bar as the page scrolls.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Large page title on top-level screens, set at a calm weight (HyperOS 4, not the iOS bold large title). In the one-handed opening it sits low, within the thumb's reach. One per screen.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: One glanceable value per screen (a timer, storage used), light and large; tabular figures.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Figures in stat cards: light and large, tabular figures. Numbers carry the expression; titles stay quiet.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section headers above groups and carousels.

styles.name: row-title
styles.usage: List row titles, read message senders. Unread senders go to 650.

styles.name: body

radius.usage: Each radius has a firm value, used under data-k-corners="firm" (KelvinCorners.Firm): a tighter scale for work apps.

frost.note: Ground glass scatters the backdrop instead of blurring it smoothly, so frost has a fine grain that stays on the pane.

tokens.name: frost-frosted
tokens.usage: Scatter radius at Frosted, the peak.

tokens.name: frost-glass
tokens.usage: Scatter radius at Glass.

tokens.name: frost-liquid
tokens.usage: Scatter radius at Liquid: almost clear.

tokens.name: thaw-radius
tokens.usage: How far frost clears around a finger. It fogs back over 900ms after release.

glass.note: The Glass level is a stepless 0-1 setting the person controls with one slider (Settings > Appearance > Glass): near-opaque ground glass at 0, bare glass at 1, nothing snaps. Kelvin derives frost, tint, the contrast floor, the horizon light and how much controls deform from it. The UI calls it Transparency; how hard the rim bends is a separate Glass setting (refraction, 0 Subtle to 1 Strong, default 0.5). The named levels below are reference points on that range.

tokens.name: glass-opaque
tokens.usage: Left end of the slider: near-opaque ground glass, a 94% coat over heavy frost. A fully opaque pane comes only from high-contrast text.

tokens.name: glass-frosted
tokens.usage: Default. Ground glass with a fine grain, 70% tint (about 30% of the frosted page shows through), a gentle bevel and warm light along the bottom edge. Every text token keeps its contrast.

tokens.name: glass-glass
tokens.usage: "Glass": 42% tint, lighter frost, the bevel visibly bends the edge, controls stretch.

tokens.name: glass-liquid
tokens.usage: "Liquid": 22% tint, almost no frost, full bevel refraction with colour fringing, the strongest stretch and wobble. The contrast floor still protects text.

tokens.name: glass-clear
tokens.usage: "Clear": fully transparent. No tint, no frost, the strongest bevel, and no contrast floor, so text over busy content can be hard to read. Settings says so next to the option. Capped to Frosted in battery saver.

tokens.name: glass-floor-light
tokens.usage: Minimum relative luminance behind text on light glass, up to Liquid. The shader lifts darker backdrop toward `glass-tint` so `glass-ink-2` stays at 4.5:1.

tokens.name: glass-floor-dark
tokens.usage: Maximum relative luminance behind text on dark glass, up to Liquid.

tokens.name: frost-opaque
tokens.usage: Frost texture, left end: a 96% coat over a 44dp blur.

tokens.name: frost-default
tokens.usage: Frost texture default: a 62% smoky coat over a deep blur, colour pushed so it glows through. Keeps the contrast floor.

tokens.name: frost-sheer
tokens.usage: Frost texture, right end: a 34% coat over a 34dp blur. Still keeps the contrast floor; no warning.
